name: JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. specializes in the engineering, manufacturing, and implementation of advanced environmental control systems, with a primary focus on mitigating air pollution and facilitating the recovery of energy and valuable resources. The company offers bespoke solutions and expert services encompassing atmospheric purification, odor abatement, smog reduction, and solvent reclamation, alongside initiatives for energy efficiency. These crucial services are extended to demanding sectors such as high-tech electronics, synthetic polyurethane leather production, coating and printing operations, and the chemical industry. Its extensive product portfolio includes sophisticated systems for managing volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, equipment designed for extracting organic solvents from waste gases, and specialized deodorization units for low-level gaseous molecular contaminants. Additionally, they provide solutions for inorganic acidic/alkaline and toxic gas treatment, control of airborne molecular contamination, thermal oxidizers for industrial exhaust streams, various energy-saving apparatus, and integrated automatic control systems. Beyond its core offerings, the company also delivers comprehensive maintenance services for high-technology manufacturing facilities. Established in 2006, JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
